- **Story:** As Ari, I want to state that a text must not be blank and must not exceed a length, so that validation is part of my phrase and not native code.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a phrase that ensures a title is not blank and at most 200 characters, When it is written without a native block and its specs run, Then a blank title fails with EmptyTitle, a 201 character title fails with TitleTooLong, a title of exactly 200 characters passes and a one character title passes (the boundary cases both sides)
  2. Given the Tasks app create phrase, When it uses these rules, Then its native count drops, its specs and build are unchanged and the error codes are the declared ones
  3. Given the vocabulary, When it is added, Then it is a base-library phrase or a language decision recorded in a Decider, not a core keyword (ADR extension map)

## Context

- Closes the validation part of finding 2. The ZOMBIES boundary cases are the acceptance (a title of 0, 1, 200 and 201 characters).
